title: Shishak's Entry into Jerusalem and Rehoboam's Humiliation
description: King Shishak of Egypt attacks Jerusalem because Judah has forsaken the Lord, but the prophet Shemaiah warns that God will spare the city when the king and leaders humble themselves. Nevertheless, Shishak plunders the house of the Lord and the king's palace, taking Solomon's gold shields with him, which are later replaced by bronze shields.
